svg.title: SAAKSHI
svg.desc: SAAKSHI, a tamper-evident cold-chain logger built for Smart India Hackathon 2026. Every reading is signed in an ATECC608B chip, hash-chained, synced over MQTT/TLS and anchored on Polygon; buyers verify a trip by QR scan. 3,606 records verified end to end, 4 of 4 tampering attacks caught, about 1,000 rupees of hardware per trip.
